answer: Social Matters >> Education & Upbringing Question ID: 2041 Country: United States of America Title: Is it okay to learn basic fiqh, basic aqeeda by ourselves and not seeking help of teacher on basic stuff? Question: Is it okay to learn basic fiqh, basic aqeeda by ourselves and not seeking help of teacher on basic stuff? Answer ID: 2041 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 657/657=M) By learning without the help of any teacher, a person may be misled and may fall in misconception; especially it is difficult to understand Fiqh and Beliefs without the help of an Aalim; therefore it is recommended to learn Fiqh and Beliefs by any teacher. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
